steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You're extremely bad-tempered, you don't ever talk, you get mad all of a sudden, and your attitude is completely terrible. No wonder I, your own sister, am the only one willing to take care of you.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You don't get along with that silly wordsmith, because you two don't accept that both word and art rose from the same source. You don't get along with me, because you don't wanna try hotpot that's even a little bit spicy—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: *sigh*, if you ever come up with those silly dishes like Metal Crab ice cream pot again, I really won't have a clue what to do with you.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Enough talk.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I'm guessing you're trying to drag this out by spewing nonsense because you're exhausted already?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...Eh, you haven't gotten even a bit of shut-eye all these years?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Pulling an all-nighter may help you keep a clear head better than losing a couple hours of sleep, but the fatigue adds up and wears you out.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, I get it. You're scared.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Grr...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You know yourself better than anyone. And you know you're part of the painting, too. And you're afraid you'll cease to exist when you wake up.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, calm down.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: We all need to face the truth about ourselves. That's not something we can run from.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Tsk.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I didn't know you could get this sentimental. Perhaps you got a little too much sleep?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: By the time 'we' wake up and gaze upon this world, both you and I as we exist right now will disappear, without a trace.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Not only that, 'we' will set this whole world ablaze with our flames of rage. The humiliation and resentment inside me will burn as well, up until the moment 'our' ties are cut.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: And I won't be particularly happy about that.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...You'll resist it?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Nonsense. How will you, a mere part of the body, take on the whole?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Eh, I think I used that analogy before.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Enough of your smooth talk. We don't have time—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Yeah, I know. I'm not the only one who thinks this way. Before 'we'—Actually, I guess since we've broken it off with those lunatics, it's not really 'we' anymore—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: —Before 'it' awakens, we need to be fully prepared. We have to be able to do this, no matter what kind of strength we need to borrow.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: And we aren't doing this for anything. It's only for ourselves and the things we love.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Also, I'm sure you noticed... Some of our siblings are on our side, some don't care, and there are some... who are absolute nut jobs.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...Impossible.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Really? Don't you actually have a few ideas about who those nut jobs are?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: They're all close to the True Lung. What chance do they... No... That's not right...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What are you doing, being more confused than I am? Just take a look back at our long history. How many times have you seen so much as a peep out of those guys?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: These days, even the big shots who like to throw their weight around send their Messengers to lounge in that little temple's side hall... It's not gonna fool me, and it's not gonna fool anyone.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Shackles can't keep you down now, can they? If not, then what makes you think anything can keep the others down?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Anyway, we really don't have much time left. It doesn't matter who drove us into this corner, there's just no time.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Do you remember the last time you had a good night's sleep?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, man, that was close. You really don't think much of your art, do you? You painted these yourself! And to think you were just lecturing me about that.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Enough nonsense.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Guessing you're not gonna admit it?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...Not necessarily. What you just said is worth giving a little thought to.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: But what does any of that have to do with the 'Rhodes Island' place? What does that have to do with what it is you want to accomplish?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You could go check it out yourself. It's a great place.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...A fair amount of us have already come to accept this fate.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: We'll disappear, and it will awaken. We will become I anew, before we all cease to exist as the destruction of the great Yan cities rings in the air.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Is there any point in that...?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: That's the answer you came up with after all these years? A little too sappy, don't you think? What happened to the haughty, arrogant Dusk I remember?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Ah, whatever. If this goes on, we'll run out of paintings to mess up. Hmph—

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Wait, not again—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, check this out. This is top of the line. It's eight feet wide, three-and-a-half tall, ignited with materials never before seen in Terra—My beloved two-step firecracker!

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...Tch.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Yo, we're back!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Nian!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My benefactor, there seems to be a burnt smell lingering in the air...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Nian's winking at us. We should probably stay away. Nothing good comes of that.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Well, I've said all there is to say. I tried to reason with you, even. What do you think?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I told you right from the start.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What good does locking yourself away in the paintings do anyway?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Come with me to Rhodes Island. It'll be just as fun there. Let's get the other guys and, hey, we can have a little family reunion over at Rhodes.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Then we can really suss out our sisterly issues, along with the rest.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Rhodes Island... What does that place have that's worth your persistence?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: And you want to bring everyone there? Ha, that's more absurd than us declaring war on Yan right now.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: If you won't come willingly, I can't just stand here and watch you lose your mind and disappear without a peep.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: That's your problem.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Ugh, don't tell me we're gonna have to fight this one out?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: That's your problem too. Dueling is incredibly boring, and, as a way to resolve differences, it went out of fashion centuries ago.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...But I will say that you've really gotten under my skin today.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Lava?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Uhh?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Stay away. Get off the mountain and go somewhere else.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What's about to go down, there's no room for you guys to interfere—

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Hm? Where am I...?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: —Ohh? Have I returned already?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Hm? Is that not Lava? Kroos and Mr. Nothing, too.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Hoh, my good sir—And who might this be? Oh, art thou perchance the master's sister? My, my, 'tis a pleasure to meet thee!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: My name is Saga, a wandering monk from the far lands of Higashi!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hah... This is getting interesting.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Uh, why the suspicious stare, may I ask? Oh, mayhaps there is rice on my face...?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Rice?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I had a magnificent vegetarian feast with many a great number of myself. Verily, the taste brought me back. It hath left me the most satisfied!

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: How did you...?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Beg pardon?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: How did you... leave my scroll?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I am afraid I know not how. I merely returned.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: All I recall is that the first person whom I met is me as I am now, and the last person whom I met is also me as I am right now. Everything that occurred between is but a faint haze, likely my random thoughts.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I walked alongside myself, the me in the painting, sharing conversations unto today, and we walked from Yan all the way back to the monastery.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: The moment I swung the door open and entered, I remembered my head priest's painting and the words he spoke as he lamented—

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Lamented?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: He said, 'The mountains are but mountains, and the water is yet water.'

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Just then, I noticed there was but a mirror in front of me. In the blink of mine eye, I found myself here.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: One final note, I must admit that the other me, having become a heavy gambler, did rather frighten me. It seems I must not take up gambling.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Heh, no wonder. Looks like your master reasoned with you just as much as I did, that little punk of a monk...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: He never saw in the scroll anything he saw in life... so it was just mountains and waters to him, hmph.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Don't be such a sore loser, my little sister. You're embarrassing yourself.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You were woken twice, but your perceptiveness and reasoning... is rather beyond my expectations.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Remember how we made a bet a long, long, loooong time ago?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You lost.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, don't even try to deny it. I know there's way more than one person who made it through the boundaries of your imagination. I will let the prior ones slide, but this happened right before my eyes.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You can stop blowing your own horn just because you're right. It'll be the end of you one day.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Remember what I said. There are always ways to turn things around.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Turn things around...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Fine. Very well... You won.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: There's no point in making a stand over this... I'll just stand by and see how far you can take it.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I guarantee you're in for a surprise, my good little sister.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Lava, nice work.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Uh, your sister doesn't seem very happy. Should we just leave her alone?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, she's fine... She's locked herself away in the paintings for years. Having to deal with this many people is probably asking too much from her right now.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Just pretend she's got some anxiety disorder, or that she's shy.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, if you're trying to strike up a conversation, you're just gonna get yelled up, Nothing bro. You don't want to bring that on yourself.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: A-Alright.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...So, I guess that wraps up the mission?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: How did you get here anyway...?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I've got my ways...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What's our next step?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Find ourselves a car or something and head back to Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Might as well take a few stops on the way to get grub. Make it a fun road trip.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Kuo-wu is known for its fine, exquisite food. If you ask me, though, I think they're tasteless and boring—

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: —Blasphemy. You'll find no finer delicacy than the scalebass here toward the end of autumn. They are plump and delicious, the perfect complement to the green mountains and rivers around us.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...Oh, scalebass is fine, but it's no match for a hotpot paired with booze.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Heh, I should have the kid show you how wrong you are. The broad variety of Yan cuisine will open your eyes.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Even hotpot is a subject of study and debate. Given how... quick with the tongue you are, I can't imagine you being an expert on the subject.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, open my eyes? That's a bit rich, coming from someone who eats nothing but ink.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Please, I wouldn't dare to lecture anyone on cuisine. Look at what you are wearing, though. It reminds me of freshly planted chilies.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: H-Hey, let's stop it, okay? And here I thought you two finally calmed down! Kroos, help me out here.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I just looked up the route back. We're gonna hit seventeen restaurants well-known for their local specialties. This will do, right?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Yeah, I suppose it'll work.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My benefactors! My benefactors! Uh, I have something I would like to mention.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What is it now? You're acting so weird, it's freaking me out...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Well, you see, I was hoping to make my way to Lungmen to find myself a job, but it appears you are all employed by this... 'Rhodes Island.' Is this island maybe hiring?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I can do anything! I am healthy and hale, quite ripped even! And I most certainly am not afraid of the Infected! I guarantee you'll get your money's worth!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Uh... you could come with us and take the exams, but I can't really promise you anything...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Very well, then please allow me to accompany you on your journey!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: This is turning into a real party.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Master.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I shall never forget the time I spent within thy scrolls.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You needn't remember it.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I am afraid these memories will stay with me for the rest of my life. Unlike thee, life is short for me.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You have my pity.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: How's your master now...?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: My head priest yet lives. Though he is already a century and a score in age, thou wilt find him quite hale and healthy.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: So you're going with them?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: No, I am afraid not... I wish to continue my travels far and wide, leaving Yan behind.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I have a dream.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Be that as it may, Lava has been a kind friend. Surely, this Rhodes Island must be a place of many fascinations. Should we have the chance, I wish to pay it a visit.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I am afraid I know not when that will be, however.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...Heh. Isn't that nice? You guys have that privilege now.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Why, I quite envy thee instead, Master Dusk. Thou need not take a step outside to enjoy the fine landscapes even thousands of miles away.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: If you've seen as many mountains as I have, life isn't going to be that much more interesting, no matter how many thousands of miles you travel.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Crude mounts utmost risen.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: If you ever meet him again, tell him: this one extra stroke wasn't bad.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Mr. Nothing, there's been a car tailing us for a while, right?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Looks like they're here for you. Need any help?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I won't trouble you so... Allow me to take care of this myself.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What happened to the promise to your master?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Why, I needn't use the fan to take care of these hooligans!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: If they dare do evil beyond the city gates under broad daylight, then there truly is no law and order left in this world! I'll teach them a lesson today—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Look, there's two more cars now.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Some of them have weapons too. Looks like they're bent on making a ruckus.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: ...M-My benefactors?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Well, if they mean us harm... Let's do this.
